lessons.title: Define a Class init
lessons.description: In Python, classes are defined using the class keyword. The __init__ constructor initializes object attributes. Create a Wizard class with name and health attributes. The test checks that Wizard("Gandalf", 120).name equals "Gandalf"; Wizard("Gandalf", 120).health equals 120.
learning_objectives: Quarry clerks recount crates before dawn, and define a class with an init constructor method.

tests.name: test_wizard_init
tests.unittest_code:
def test_wizard_init(self):
    w = Wizard("Gandalf", 120)
    self.assertEqual(w.name, "Gandalf")
    self.assertEqual(w.health, 120)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Classes — __init__ constructor (Python Tutorial)

lessons.title: Practice Instance Methods
lessons.description: Instance methods take self as their first parameter and can modify or read instance state. Add a take_damage(amount) method to Wizard. The test checks that Wizard("Merlin", 100).health equals 70.

tests.name: test_take_damage
tests.unittest_code:
def test_take_damage(self):

    self.assertEqual(w.health, 70)

lessons.title: Practice Space Station Life Support
lessons.description: Finish add_crew_member, consume_oxygen. Model a SpaceStation with crew count, oxygen level, and life support methods. The test checks that SpaceStation("ISS", 2).crew equals ["Alice"]; SpaceStation("ISS", 5).oxygen_level equals 80.
learning_objectives: Depot clerks recount crates before dawn, and build a complete class modeling real-world system state.

tests.name: test_add_crew
tests.unittest_code:
def test_add_crew(self):
    station = SpaceStation("ISS", 2)
    station.add_crew_member("Alice")
    self.assertEqual(station.crew, ["Alice"])

tests.name: test_consume_oxygen
tests.unittest_code:
def test_consume_oxygen(self):
    station = SpaceStation("ISS", 5)
    station.add_crew_member("Alice")
    station.add_crew_member("Bob")
    station.consume_oxygen(5)
    self.assertEqual(station.oxygen_level, 80)

lessons.title: Practice Bank Account Transaction Log
lessons.description: Implement a BankAccount class with deposit, withdraw, and balance history. The test checks that BankAccount("Charlie", 100).balance equals 150; BankAccount("Charlie", 100).balance equals 120; BankAccount("Charlie", 100).withdraw(30) is true.
learning_objectives: Ridge clerks recount crates before dawn, and encapsulate state and transaction logic in a class.

tests.name: test_bank_account
tests.unittest_code:
def test_bank_account(self):
    acc = BankAccount("Charlie", 100)
    acc.deposit(50)
    self.assertEqual(acc.balance, 150)
    self.assertTrue(acc.withdraw(30))
    self.assertEqual(acc.balance, 120)
    self.assertFalse(acc.withdraw(500))

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Classes — mutating instance state in methods (Python Tutorial)
